diagnostic.help: refine each transition by exactly one net

related.message: first refine of shop.[deliver] was declared here

source.text:
composition refined_order_conflict

use "order_flow.petrinet" as shop
use "courier.petrinet" as courier
use "courier.petrinet" as bike
wire shop.(sending) -> courier.(pickup)
wire courier.(dropped) -> shop.(delivered)
refine shop.[deliver] by courier
refine shop.[deliver] by bike
